backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the membership management system with CRUD operations for members, login activity tracking, ID card requests, access control via admin roles, and filtering/sorting capabilities.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms legacy Submission records from the old canister state into the new Member-based data model, preserving user profiles and initializing new collections.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (navigation button, membership form, login page, dashboard) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated summary document describing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, hooks, and utilities across the application.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar) using the OKLCH color system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app titled 'KATTAR SANATANI YODHA', including Google site verification meta tag and Google AdSense script.
frontend/public/ads.txt: Google AdSense ads.txt authorization file declaring the publisher ID for direct ad serving.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with eleven routes (home, about, programs, philosophy, resources, contact, donate, admin, membership, login, dashboard) under a shared Layout root route.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, quick navigation links, contact info (email, phone, location), and social media icons for Facebook, X, WhatsApp, and YouTube.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, organization title, Sanskrit tagline, Hindi description, and CTA buttons to donate or learn more.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a sticky Navigation header, a main content outlet, and a Footer.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Displays the organization's four core values (Bhakti, Raksha, Gyan, Ekta) as icon cards in a responsive grid with Hindi descriptions.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with desktop and mobile menus, active-link highlighting, member login/logout controls, and an admin shield icon button.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Reusable card component that displays a Lucide icon, title, and description for a single program entry.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Renders four support option cards (volunteer time, spread awareness, contribute skills, share knowledge) each linking to the contact page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Hook managing contact form submission state; the actual backend call is disabled and always returns an error, directing users to contact directly.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login, logout, identity, and status state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useMemberAuth.tsx: Provides a React context and hook for member authentication, handling login/logout state with localStorage persistence and mutation via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useMemberQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating member-related data including members, ID card requests, login activities, and member registration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to check if the caller is an admin and to fetch the caller's user profile from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing fonts and defining Tailwind base styles with a Sanatani-inspired warm color palette (saffron, gold, terracotta) for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page displaying the organization's story, mission, vision, values, and community principles in Hindi using a card-based layout.
frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx: Admin dashboard page with Internet Identity authentication gating, displaying tabbed views of members, ID card requests, and login activities with search and sort controls.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a form for name, email, phone, WhatsApp, and message fields with validation, plus contact info and social media links.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donation page displaying a hero section, support options component, impact area breakdown with progress bars, and a transparency commitment section, all in Hindi.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page composing the Hero and Mission components alongside a 'What We Do' highlights grid and a call-to-action section with links to donate and contact pages.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Member login page with email/phone and password fields, error display, and navigation to the dashboard on success or to the membership registration page.
frontend/src/pages/MemberDashboard.tsx: Authenticated member dashboard showing profile details, membership status, and an ID card request feature, with logout functionality and redirect to login if unauthenticated.
frontend/src/pages/Membership.tsx: Member registration form collecting personal, location, and credential fields along with photo and Aadhaar file uploads, with validation and submission via the useRegisterMember hook.
frontend/src/pages/Philosophy.tsx: Philosophy page presenting Sanatan Dharma teachings through sections on its eternal nature, unwavering devotion, and exemplary devotional figures like Ram, Hanuman, and Yudhishthira.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Displays a Programs page for a Hindu cultural organization, rendering a grid of six program cards (e.g., Vedic Study Circle, Youth Education) and an impact statistics section, all with Hindi text.
frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx: Renders a Resources page with categorized spiritual/educational materials (sacred texts, videos, articles, downloads) and four featured resources with external links, all described in Hindi.
frontend/src/utils/locationData.ts: Exports a typed dataset of countries with nested states and districts, primarily covering Indian states with Hindi district names, for use in location selection forms.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routing, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, custom fonts (Inter, Cormorant Garamond, Cinzel), extended border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, plus typography and container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state, version, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of existing features for a Hindi-language political party membership web app. Describes features like member registration, login, dashboard, ID card requests, and an admin panel.
